race.title: Prancing To The Pilsner Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NORTH OF RICHMOND put a disappointing handicap debut behind him when scoring at Newcastle on his reappearance and it's reasonable to assume he could have further improvement in the pipeline given his lightly-raced profile, so a 2 lb higher mark looks well within his compass. Virtual Rock is thriving for his current yard and shouldn't be inconvenienced by the return to 2m given how he goes through his races, with Caelan completing the shortlist. NORTH OF RICHMOND (IRE) VIRTUAL ROCK (IRE) CAELAN (IRE)
